messages.subject: R/qtl2 on crossinfo
parts: I was using a magic population of 8 parents for research and encountered some problems when importing data: I made a cross_info as described, but when I ran it, I got a hint that cross_info should have 8 columns, indicating the order of the cross, and how I could modify it to run successfully.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] R/qtl2 on crossinfo
parts:
With cross type “riself8”, the cross_info file should include line ID and the 8 columns indicating the cross direction. There should be a column with number of generations, so delete that 2nd column in your file and then I think it should be okay.

There also might be some problems with genotype codes in the founder_geno data.

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] R/qtl2 on crossinfo
parts:
The genotypes and founder genotypes get converted to integer values 1/2/3 for AA/AB/BB, and 0 for missing.
See the description of the “Genotype codes” in the section about the control file: https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/input_files.html#Control_file

It may be that your founder genotypes include some heterozygotes, which are not allowed and get treated as missing values.

karl
